title: core.session.ended v1
description: A session's call ended (System Design, Event catalog; D57). Starts the scribe when both people consented and the seeker did not refuse for this session. Ids and codes only.

scribe.description: True when audio was recorded for the scribe.

audioKey.description: Object key of the session audio, present whenever audio was recorded. With scribe false (refused during the session), the AI service only deletes it.

sessionLanguage.description: ISO 639 code of the session language.

guest.description: True when the seeker booked as a guest; subjectId is then the guest contact's id.
